lemma.note: Kaikki Old Norse s.v. vísa, noun *wīsǭ; root-level only.
Zoega s.v. hrista; shaking verb, not rísta; no new PIE etymon asserted.
Kaikki Old Norse s.v. vísi, agent noun from vísa; exclude adjective *weydsos.
Kaikki Old Norse s.v. hár, noun *hērą; exclude high *hauhaz; no secure replacement asserted.
Zoega s.v. raun; trial/proof, not hraun; https://norse.ulver.com/dct/zoega/r.html
Zoega s.v. sætta; reconciliation, not sweetening; https://norse.ulver.com/dct/zoega/s.html
Kaikki Old Norse s.v. bœr/bǿr; dwelling noun, not bærr carrying; no replacement asserted.
Kroonen 2013 s.v. *warma-, p.575 (scan p0615): *gʷʰor-mo-; target wórmos belongs to worm root in this lexicon.
Zoega s.v. vara, wares; exclude vera; no replacement asserted.
Zoega s.v. vax; wax noun, not vaxa; no new inherited equation asserted. https://norse.ulver.com/dct/zoega/v.html
Zoega s.v. fœða verb; born, not foot or the food noun. https://norse.ulver.com/dct/zoega/f.html
Kaikki Old Norse s.v. væringi; oath/pledge formation; alternative compound analysis does not justify whole-lexeme walking equation.
Kaikki Old Norse s.v. hrár < *hrawaz; Kroonen 2013 s.v. *hrawa-, p.244 (scan p0284), *krowh₂-o-; root-level only.
Kaikki Old Norse s.v. úlfr; lexicon s.v. *wĺ̥kʷos, wolf.
Kaikki Old Norse s.v. ǫrn < *arnuz; lexicon s.v. *h₃érō, eagle.
